# A22 — World-Picture → World-Atlas

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A22′ — The Atlas, Not the Camera](conjugate/A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

A world-atlas makes situated accounts traversable. Each picture remains placed; its overlaps, transformations and obstructions become part of what it says. [[A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency|Contextual transparency]] discloses how a view is conditioned; [[A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|differential placement]] keeps the particular aperture effective; an [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|invested image]] remains answerable where its source can correct what the image is permitted to show. Their conjunction changes how inquiry can use a picture without making its framing conditions the last word.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology|Heidegger’s world-picture diagnosis]] concerns a historical event: the world is grasped as picture while the representer becomes its normative centre. The existence of pictures alone does not establish that diagnosis. Taylor’s constructive atlas follows the place, frame and permissible transitions of several disclosures; it extends the inquiry through a different operation rather than attributing the proposal to Heidegger.

## #1

A picture has a frame before its contents are assembled. The box-lid image gives a jigsaw its finished arrangement in advance; every piece is then judged by the place that arrangement assigns. Inquiry becomes different when travel discloses the frame's own conditions or encounters a piece whose relation cannot be settled by the lid. Collecting more pieces cannot alone correct the criterion of fit.

In Taylor’s stained-glass development, light, panes, lead cames, aperture, viewer and cast image work together. Each pane transmits, colours and interrupts; the cames preserve seams and non-equivalences. Moving light or viewer changes the visible pattern through the same constructed window. A source’s difference informs the composition rather than becoming an impurity removed by averaging. The composed image is a context of transmission in which the distinct producing relations remain consequential.

A world-picture is also a **Project** thrown forth within a **Paradigm**: a pattern of disclosure has already helped decide what can appear, count and fit. The atlas becomes reflexive by making those paradigmatic conditions comparable — source, gauge, frame, admitted transition, exclusion and situated viewer. In [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD|paradigm through projection and enactment]], `/↔1` relates the particular expression to the operation which gives it force. A returned obstruction can then change a producing condition, rather than merely add another picture. This is Taylor’s constructive relation, distinct from the historical Heidegger diagnosis and the hypotheses of mathematical atlas theory.

## #2

An atlas requires declared conditions of transition. For local charts with coordinate maps `φᵢ` and `φⱼ`, an overlap permits the transition `φⱼ ∘ φᵢ⁻¹` on the relevant domain. This mathematical operation has explicit hypotheses: the maps must have the required inverse and common region, and the transition must satisfy the structure being studied. A collection of incompatible descriptions does not become a mathematical atlas by being stored together.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics|Symbolon Dynamics]] distinguishes chart transition from attractor movement. A basin organises trajectories; an atlas coordinates partial disclosures. Their objects remain distinct through the symbolic comparison. In the epistemic extension, a transition states the question, scale, assumptions, preserved distinctions and actual relation which changes. It identifies whether the judging criterion is retained or revised and why. An obstruction makes the limit explicit: these accounts cannot yet be composed for this purpose under these conditions. The unresolved result can guide another encounter without manufacturing agreement.

A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas|world-atlas]] keeps adequacy discriminating. Some accounts fail their own tests, some address different objects, and some genuinely conflict. Making these differences intelligible gives inquiry a warranted next route: correct the view, change the transition, narrow its domain, seek another source or retain the fitting relation with reasons.

## #3

The [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|Bimba–Pratibimba relation]] locates the atlas within its own producing field. Every produced world-picture, including an instrument’s reference map and this atlas, is pratibimba relative to its wider sources. Inside a declared Context Frame it can genuinely serve as Bimba, a local original for downstream readings. This recursively situated office has real, revisable authority; the artifact remains dependent on the wider relation through which it acquired that office. Its causal priority in a later circuit does not make it metaphysically Original.

A locally authoritative map can organise what later projects encounter and become causally prior within that circuit. Its construction therefore stays recoverable. A projected reference becomes counterfeit sourcehood when wider sources can appear only under categories the projection makes immune to answer. Conversely, an obstruction becomes paradigmatic evidence where it can correct a source, reference, transition or frame at the warranted site. An unexpected answer can correct a view under a fitting rule; exposed failure of the rule requires a route to its deciding office. Atlas-making keeps **projection consequential without making projection originary**.

The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses|twelve-lens architecture]] changes the governing relation through which the same full Name/Power field is received. L4 and L4′ each carry the whole rotated constellation, grounded from opposite faces. Choosing a lens changes what serves as source, means, measure and determining centre; it does not delete the other offices. Exact musical selections have their own mathematical tests; historical assignments require their historical sources; epistemic utility requires a comparison which actually exercises the changed determining relation. A scale table alone cannot supply the latter two warrants.

## #4

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin|Gebser’s perspectival and aperspectival comparison]] asks how a sector-view can become available within co-presence. Taylor’s `180°→360°` development turns toward the field of positions and transformations which makes the views possible. The viewer remains situated within that field. In his direct P5 interpretation, context is a being-with the text and subtext, invested in outcome and care; that interpretation gives the proposed atlas a receiving consequence without assigning its wording to Gebser.

In [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Region → Name/Countenance → Account]], a placed and counted participant remains a face able to answer the count. The returned account can correct an assigned place, recover an omitted source or expose a failed framing condition. Name and number have distinct lexical histories; their operational conjunction follows what counting and answering actually change.

## #5→0

Symbolic change follows trajectories; the atlas follows chart transitions. The [historical comparison](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT-language-symbol-dialogue.md#language-dialogue) keeps their objects and warrants distinct while following how an achieved account enters another encounter. Source-specific transformations, rather than a common image alone, make the proposed relation available for judgment.

In [Bohm’s running-true comparison](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm.md), the 18 May 1975 conversation moves through a spinning wheel and straight-running thread. Taylor’s separate mathematical continuation uses multiplication by i to change phase while preserving modulus. A chart passage likewise states its transformation and preserved relation. Neither a physical image nor a complex-plane rotation certifies every transition between epistemic worlds. Obstruction and the participants’ unresolved formulations stay visible where their particular operations resist composition.

In [Māyā’s stained-window and holographic movement](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction), panes, seams and changing placements disclose different projections under explicit conditions. An achieved image can genuinely serve as local Bimba within a declared Context Frame while remaining pratibimba relative to its wider sources. Travel brings evidence which can revise that local reference, rather than requiring a spectator outside the field.

In Taylor’s [Necker cube](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#necker-cube), unchanged lines permit opposed readings; contextual recognition can disclose how both arise. The [centre-everywhere relation](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#centre-everywhere) opens real nested internalities: a situated centre’s world leads into further centres without acquiring a final exterior circumference. The atlas retains the transitions and the viewer’s place within them. Installing a spectator outside every traversed world would lose that relation.

In [the travelling jigsaw](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-travel-and-reconstruction), the same puzzle whose box-lid predetermined every fit becomes available through a journey exposing its framing activity. Pieces can participate as local charts where overlaps and transitions are declared. The first picture survives as a situated achievement; a changed fit, route or source can alter the next reconstruction.

In [stained-glass return](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-return), the changed reader re-enters source, pane, seam and exclusion. An achieved map serves as local original within its declared Context Frame while reflecting wider sources. The reader’s changed placement can therefore make another distinction visible or expose a seam the prior composition concealed. That evidence can correct the local reference through its actual producing conditions.

An [account which retains its source](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md#account-does-not-replace-source) carries the chart’s conditions and limits of transition. Returned obstruction can change the comparison rather than being hidden by accumulating more pictures. The corrected source, narrowed domain, altered route or warranted retention becomes a condition of the next inquiry, with its evidential limits still available.

In [paradigm through projection and enactment](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD-genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos.md#1--paradigm-through-project-projection--enactment), a chart or local Bimba becomes a real condition of later action. Its determinations expose the paradigm through which they were made legible; encountered resistance can alter that mediation. A project returns through its paradigm by making the implicated source or condition answerable. An exposed failure warrants the relevant correction; a fitting condition can be retained with reasons. The next act inherits that judgment together with the project’s history and its distinction from the mediation through which it became possible.

In the [uroboric position and opposition](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-position-opposition), circumference remains a valid view. Opening the apparently closed form discloses body, aperture and orientation omitted when that view claimed the whole. The new relation preserves what the outline shows while making its conditions available for another reading.

The invariant remains `world ≠ world-model`. Rich representations and a federation’s many models do not exhaust the world in which they were learned and into which their actions return. [[A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|Active objective internality]] includes the materials, institutions, memories and interpersonal relations through which an event can be encountered. A disclosed harness records particular conditions within that whole inquiry; the event can still resist its represented account.

In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief|Agentworld’s divergent worlds]], a common grammar lets disagreement acquire shape while the world-models remain different. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|Deference]] lets the exposed difference reach source, answer, model, evaluator or commission at its warranted depth. [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|Operational parity]] asks what later act inherits the resulting correction or reasoned retention. The atlas continues through a changed route, sharper obstruction or newly situated account, without assuming that every encounter must replace its criterion.
